name: Queen Cobra & The No-Eye-Deer
source:
When a legendary diamond is stolen from the Museum of Totally Not Stolen Artifacts, Queen Cobra must find the culprit with the help of her paramour Captain Blood, aka Secretary of the Museum's Board of Directors. Finger the right person and be a hero... or get the wrong person and sleep on the couch!

[From [url=https://ms45.itch.io/queen-cobra-the-no-eye-deer-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
